cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You brought soup? I'll organize your dinners for the week. Nobody looks after me without getting more back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my plan starts when I'm better. I'll fill yours twice; you can choose every meal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just bring back the empty tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tubs first, naturally. I'll bring them back full and buy a freezer to fit them. You choose the size and where it goes. I'll work around you; I still owe you the bigger favor.

reason: Give A a confident repayment plan that concedes timing, food and storage choices to B while insistently increasing the return above each caring contribution.
